subtitle: Cross-analysis of September 17, 2026, reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT (16:21 UTC), with the presidential book at USD 150.87M. The five tracked contracts received a new price in this round: winner, first-round runner-up, first-round third place, Supreme Court impeachment and Senate. On the polling side, three national polls were released today: AtlasIntel (fieldwork from Sep 11 to 16, 5,018 online interviews, margin of 1.0pp, BR-06221/2026), PoderData (fieldwork from Sep 13 to 16, 3,000 automated telephone interviews, margin of 1.8pp, BR-00360/2026) and Gerp (fieldwork from Sep 14 to 16, 2,400 telephone interviews, margin of 2pp, BR-00535/2026).

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 44.50% (vol USD 11.19M accumulated) in the winner contract, reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, with no movement against the price confirmed on Sep 16. POLLS: in the first round 44.1% in AtlasIntel, 37% in PoderData and 37% in Gerp; in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro 46.8%, 44% and 43%.
fortes: Leads the first round in the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17, 44.1% to 41.7%, a 2.4-point distance that falls outside two margins of 1.0, and in PoderData, 37% to 36%.

Wins the four other AtlasIntel runoff pairs, all outside two margins: 46.3% to 43.7% against Romeu Zema, 46.0% to 41.7% against Ronaldo Caiado, 45.6% to 37.8% against Augusto Cury and 46.1% to 29.7% against Renan Santos.
In AtlasIntel and PoderData the runoff pair against Flávio Bolsonaro fits inside the margins, which is a statistical tie in both houses.
fracos: Stays flat at 44.50% in the winner contract while Flávio Bolsonaro rises, and the gap widens from 9.25pp to 10.20pp.
Appears numerically behind Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff in all three national polls of Sep 17, and in Gerp the 7-point distance falls outside two margins.
In AtlasIntel his first-round lead narrowed from 5.6 to 2.4 points against the Sep 10 round. In the first-round runner-up contract he gives up 1.20pp, to 22.65%.
candidates.analise: The round is one of a flat price and three polls that each repeat their own previous runoff reading. In the winner contract he stays at 44.50% (vol USD 11.19M accumulated), and the gap to Flávio Bolsonaro widens from 9.25pp to 10.20pp only through the opponent's move. In the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro PoderData keeps the 2-point distance, Gerp the 7-point one and AtlasIntel goes from 0.2 to 0.4 point: the houses disagree more with one another than each one moves. In the first round he leads in AtlasIntel and PoderData and trails in Gerp, and it is in AtlasIntel that his lead narrows, from 5.6 to 2.4 points. AtlasIntel also measures 45.4% government approval against 53.6% disapproval. In the first-round runner-up contract he gives up 1.20pp, to 22.65%.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 54.70% (vol USD 10.88M accumulated) in the winner contract, reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, up 0.95pp against the price confirmed on Sep 16. POLLS: in the first round 41.7% in AtlasIntel, 36% in PoderData and 40% in Gerp; in the runoff against Lula 47.2%, 46% and 50%.
fortes: Rises 0.95pp in the winner contract, to 54.70%, 0.40pp below his series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10, and the gap to Lula widens from 9.25pp to 10.20pp.
Appears ahead of Lula in the runoff in all three national polls of Sep 17, and in Gerp the 7 points, 50% to 43%, fall outside two margins.
In AtlasIntel he rises from 37.4% to 41.7% in the first round against the Sep 10 round, and in Gerp he leads the first round 40% to 37%.
fracos: In AtlasIntel and PoderData his runoff lead, of 0.4 and 2 points, fits inside the margins, so those two houses measure a statistical tie.
Still trails Lula in the first round in AtlasIntel, by 2.4 points, outside two margins, and in PoderData, by 1 point.
candidates.analise: The round is one of a market rise and of stability within each house in the runoff. In the winner contract he rises 0.95pp, to 54.70% (vol USD 10.88M accumulated), with Lula flat, and sits 0.40pp below the series high, of 55.10% on Sep 10. The three national polls of Sep 17 put him ahead in the runoff, and each repeats the distance of its own previous round: 0.4 point in AtlasIntel, 2 in PoderData and 7 in Gerp. The movement that exists is in the AtlasIntel first round, where he rises from 37.4% to 41.7%. The panel does not claim the price reacted to any of the three: the order between the measurements is not measured. In the first-round runner-up contract he rises 1.00pp, to 76.50%.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.15% in the winner contract, reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, down 0.10pp. In the first-round third-place contract he falls 2.60pp against the price confirmed on Sep 16, to 42.90% (vol USD 215 thousand accumulated), and is no longer the favorite. POLLS: in the first round 3.5% in AtlasIntel, 8% in PoderData and 7% in Gerp.
fortes: He is third in the first round in PoderData, with 8%, and in Gerp, with 7%, ahead of Renan Santos in both.
In PoderData he beats Lula in the runoff 45% to 42%, a distance that fits inside two margins of 1.8.
fracos: In the first-round third-place contract he falls 2.60pp, to 42.90%, and sits 1.10pp behind Renan Santos, who was 9.00pp lower the day before.

In AtlasIntel he falls from 6.6% to 3.5% in the first round against the Sep 10 round, and loses the runoff to Lula 37.8% to 45.6%. In the winner contract the 0.15% sits below the lowest value of the recorded readings in his series, of 0.30% on Sep 10.
candidates.analise: The round changes the favorite of the contract in which he has a relevant price. In first-round third place he falls 2.60pp, to 42.90% (vol USD 215 thousand accumulated), and Renan Santos moves ahead. Today's polls do not agree on that swap: in PoderData he has 8% and in Gerp 7%, both ahead of Renan Santos, and in AtlasIntel he falls from 6.6% to 3.5%, behind him. In the runoff against Lula PoderData puts him 3 points ahead, inside two margins, and AtlasIntel 7.8 points behind, outside them. In the winner contract he gives up 0.10pp, to 0.15%.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 1.15% (vol USD 13.60M accumulated) in the winner contract, reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, down 0.20pp. In the first-round third-place contract he rises 7.50pp against the price confirmed on Sep 16, to 44.00% (vol USD 324 thousand accumulated), and becomes the favorite. POLLS: in the first round 5.1% in AtlasIntel, 3% in PoderData and 2% in Gerp.
fortes: In the first-round third-place contract he rises 7.50pp, to 44.00%, and moves ahead of Augusto Cury, now 1.10pp behind him. It is also the contract with the largest accumulated volume in that book, USD 324 thousand.
In the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17 he is third in the first round, with 5.1%, ahead of Augusto Cury, with 3.5%.
His winner contract is the second largest by accumulated volume in the presidential book, USD 13.60M, behind only Tarcísio de Freitas's.
fracos: In the winner contract he gives up 0.20pp, to 1.15%, below the lowest value of the recorded readings in his series, of 1.20% on Aug 31.

In PoderData and Gerp he trails Augusto Cury in the first round, with 3% and 2%, and in AtlasIntel he falls from 6.5% to 5.1% against the Sep 10 round. He loses the runoff to Lula in AtlasIntel 29.7% to 46.1%.
candidates.analise: The round moves his two contracts in opposite directions. In first-round third place he rises 7.50pp, to 44.00% (vol USD 324 thousand accumulated), and moves ahead of Augusto Cury. In the winner contract he gives up 0.20pp, to 1.15% (vol USD 13.60M accumulated), below the lowest value of the recorded readings in the series. Of today's three national polls, only AtlasIntel puts him ahead of Cury in the first round, 5.1% to 3.5%, and even there he falls 1.4 points against the Sep 10 round; PoderData and Gerp put Cury 5 points ahead. The panel does not claim the third-place book reacted to AtlasIntel. High volume in the winner contract measures interest accumulated since opening, not probability now.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado at 0.15% in the winner contract, stable, reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT; Romeu Zema at 0.05%, down 0.10pp; Fernando Haddad at 0.05%, stable. In the first-round third-place contract Ronaldo Caiado falls 3.00pp against the price confirmed on Sep 16, to 12.50% (vol USD 133 thousand accumulated). POLLS: Ronaldo Caiado with 1.7% in AtlasIntel and 3% in PoderData and Gerp; Romeu Zema with 1.1% in AtlasIntel and 1% in PoderData.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack, with prices from the reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT and polls from AtlasIntel, PoderData and Gerp of Sep 17.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.15% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the first-round THIRD-PLACE contract he falls 3.00pp, to 12.50%, in a book of USD 133 thousand. He has 1.7% in the AtlasIntel first round and 3% in PoderData and Gerp.
caiado.fortes: He has 3% in the PoderData first round, tied with Renan Santos, and 3% in Gerp, ahead of him.
caiado.fracos: Loses the runoff pair to Lula in AtlasIntel by 4.3 points, outside two margins, and falls 3.00pp in the first-round third-place contract. In the winner contract he stays at 0.15%.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, at the book's floor. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and the national polls of Sep 17 do not test him in a first-round presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in today's reading, so there is no movement to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on May 26.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the first round by the national polls of Sep 17, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, confirmed reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, down 0.10pp, at the book's floor. He has 1.1% in the AtlasIntel first round and 1% in PoderData.
zema.fortes: He is Lula's closest opponent in the runoff pairs of the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17, with 43.7% against 46.3%.
zema.fracos: In the Sep 10 AtlasIntel round he appeared 0.2 point ahead of Lula in the runoff, and today he sits 2.6 points behind, outside two margins. In the winner contract he falls to 0.05%, and his series high is 12.00%, on May 13.

candidates.analise: The round moves the three little in the winner contract: Ronaldo Caiado stays at 0.15%, Romeu Zema falls from 0.15% to 0.05% and Fernando Haddad stays at 0.05%. The largest move is Caiado's in the first-round third-place contract, where he falls 3.00pp, to 12.50%. In the polls, the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17 measures both candidates in runoff pairs against Lula and both lose outside two margins: Zema by 2.6 points, after appearing 0.2 point ahead on Sep 10, and Caiado by 4.3 points, after tying at 45.7% on Sep 10.
fortes: Romeu Zema is Lula's closest opponent in the runoff pairs of the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17, 2.6 points behind.
Ronaldo Caiado has 3% in the PoderData and Gerp first round.
Fernando Haddad and Ronaldo Caiado were stable in the winner contract in today's reading.
fracos: The three add up to 0.25% in the winner contract, and none of them exceeds 0.15% individually.
In AtlasIntel the pairs of Zema and Caiado against Lula worsen against the Sep 10 round and fall outside two margins.
Fernando Haddad is not measured in the first round by the national polls of Sep 17, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round.

quadroComparativo.p: In the AtlasIntel poll of Sep 17 (fieldwork from Sep 11 to 16, 5,018 online interviews, margin of 1.0pp) he has 44.1% in the first round, ahead, and 46.8% in the runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro's 47.2%, inside the margin. In the PoderData poll of Sep 17 he has 37% in the first round and 44% to 46% in the runoff, and in the Gerp poll of Sep 17 37% and 43% to 50%.

quadroComparativo.t: flat, and the gap to the leader widens from 9.25pp to 10.20pp through the opponent's move

cruzamento: 📈 THE GAP IN THE WINNER CONTRACT WIDENED FROM 9.25pp TO 10.20pp WITH ONLY ONE SIDE MOVING: Flávio Bolsonaro rose from 53.75% to 54.70% (vol USD 10.88M), 0.40pp below his series high, and Lula stayed at 44.50% (vol USD 11.19M), reading of Sep 17, 13:21 BRT, against the price confirmed on Sep 16. 🗳️ THREE NATIONAL POLLS WERE RELEASED ON Sep 17, AtlasIntel, PoderData and Gerp, and in the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula each house repeats the distance of its own previous round: 2 points in PoderData, 46% to 44%, as on Sep 10; 7 points in Gerp, 50% to 43%, as on Sep 9; and 0.4 point in AtlasIntel, 47.2% to 46.8%, against 0.2 on Sep 10. All three put Flávio Bolsonaro numerically ahead. ⚠️ The difference BETWEEN the houses, from 0.4 to 7 points, is larger than the movement of any of them against itself: in PoderData and AtlasIntel the pair fits inside the margins and is a statistical tie, and in Gerp it falls outside two margins. In the first round the one that moves is AtlasIntel, where Lula's lead over Flávio Bolsonaro narrowed from 5.6 to 2.4 points. 🥉 IN THE FIRST-ROUND THIRD-PLACE CONTRACT RENAN SANTOS PASSED AUGUSTO CURY, 44.00% to 42.90%, after rising 7.50pp, and today's polls do not agree on that order: AtlasIntel puts Renan Santos ahead and PoderData and Gerp put Cury ahead. 🏛️ IN THE SUPREME COURT, EDSON FACHIN REMOVED ON Sep 17 FROM THE Sep 23 AGENDA THE JUDGMENT OF THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE ANDRÉ MENDONÇA, with no new date, and the analysis on Alexandre de Moraes remains on Flávio Dino's review request. The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 5.05%, 0.20pp above the previous day, with almost no new money in the book. The panel does not claim the market reacted to any poll or to the procedure.
